fact: The World Bank's 29 June 2026 press release says the programme supports Kenya's Enhanced Single Registry as the main platform for identifying social-assistance beneficiaries, reducing duplication.
The KSEIP 2 environmental and social management plan says the Enhanced Single Registry is a national database for poor and vulnerable households used by the government's National Safety Net Program.

The document says all National Safety Net Programme cash transfers (HSNP, OPCT, CT-OVC, PwSD-CT) use the Enhanced Single Registry, with poverty targeting for all except the OPCT, which is not poverty-targeted.
Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said households were identified through the State Department for Social Protection's Enhanced Single Registry to be sponsored under the Social Health Authority.
